approved.en: Russia is expanding glide-bomb production and urging underground data centres after Ukrainian drone attacks, while daily Russian strikes continue, killing two civilians and injuring 35 across Ukraine. Ukraine has carried out deep-strike missions up to 2,500 km, hitting a chemical plant in Voronezh, a missile-battery plant in Yelets, and other sites such as a titanium plant, a Tolyatti factory and a Krasnodar Krai airfield. European defence ministers met in Paris to discuss support and the UK and France are conducting joint exercises aimed at Crimea, as Zelenskyy says trilateral peace talks with Russia are set to restart. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russland utvider produksjonen av glidebomber og oppfordrer til underjordiske datasentre etter ukrainske dronerangrep, mens daglige russiske angrep fortsetter, og drar to sivile i døden og skader 35 i hele Ukraina. Ukraina har gjennomført dype angrep på opptil 2 500 km, og har truffet et kjemisk anlegg i Voronezh, et missilbatterianlegg i Yelets og andre mål som et titan-anlegg, en fabrikk i Tolyatti og en flyplass i Krasnodar Krai. Europeiske forsvarsministre møttes i Paris for å diskutere støtte, og Storbritannia og Frankrike holder felles øvelser rettet mot Krim, mens Zelenskyy sier at trilaterale fredssamtaler med Russland skal gjenopptas. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. approved.en: Iran is mobilising a nationwide self-sacrifice campaign, threatening diplomats and preparing possible strikes while Houthis continue attacks on Saudi oil facilities and airports, prompting the reopening of Riyadh Airport after weeks of disruption. Egypt has approved military aid for Saudi Arabia and its parliament authorised the support as Houthi attacks intensify. Delegations from Mecca defence pact states are meeting in Tehran to defuse Iran-US and Yemen tensions, while Iran’s anti-negotiation hardliners have turned against President Pezeshkian. Netanyahu has reportedly pressured the military to attack Iran ahead of elections and Eisenkot called him hysterical after Netanyahu posted an AI image of a nuclear blast on Tel Aviv. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Egypt har godkjent militærhjelp til Saudi-Arabia og parlamentet autoriserte støtten ettersom houthi-angrepene intensiveres. Delegasjoner fra Mekka-forsvarspakt-statene møtes i Teheran for å dempe Iran-USA‑ og Jemen-spenninger, mens Irans anti-forhandlingshardlinere har vendt seg mot president Pezeshkian. Netanyahu har ifølge rapporter presset militæret til å angripe Iran før valget, og Eisenkot kalte ham hysterisk etter at Netanyahu la ut et AI-bilde av en atomeksplosjon over Tel Aviv. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall har skjedd i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Houthis have intensified attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking Riyadh airport and targeting missile facilities and oil infrastructure, while Saudi air defenses have intercepted many drones and missiles. Saudi-led coalition forces have responded by destroying Houthi missile tunnels, launchers and storage sites in Yemen and by using a Maven-like AI system to locate Houthi missiles. Egypt's parliament has authorized military support for Saudi Arabia to help defend against these attacks. Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan have held rare talks with Iran as Houthi strikes continue. A French FREMM frigate shot down a ballistic missile near a Belgian minehunter.

Saudi-ledde koalisjonsstyrker har svart ved å ødelegge houthi-missiltunneler, avfyringsramper og lagringssteder i Jemen, og ved å bruke et Maven-lignende AI-system for å lokalisere houthi-missiler. Egypts parlament har godkjent militær støtte til Saudi-Arabia for å hjelpe til med forsvaret mot disse angrepene. Saudi-Arabia, Tyrkia og Pakistan har holdt sjeldne samtaler med Iran mens houthi-angrepene fortsetter. Et fransk FREMM-kryssere har skutt ned en ballistisk missil i nærheten av en belgisk minerydder.

approved.en: Jordan has launched airstrikes and ground attacks against militants in southern Syria, citing retaliation for a deadly church attack that killed nine people. Syrian authorities have imposed new restrictions on women, banning them from university courses and limiting admission to security-focused universities, while a delegation from the Interior Ministry attended a security university graduation in Riyadh. A car bomb on the Damascus-Homs highway killed several people, and a separate drone strike on the same highway killed three individuals, according to defense sources. Additionally, a target linked to Abu Abdul Rahman al-Libi was reportedly engaged near Qara in Syria.

Syriske myndigheter har innført nye restriksjoner på kvinner, forbyr dem fra universitetsstudier og begrenser opptak til sikkerhetsfokuserte universiteter, mens en delegasjon fra Innenministeriet deltok på en sikkerhetsuniversitetsutdeling i Riyadh. En bilbombe på motorveien Damascus-Homs drepte flere personer, og et separat droneredskap på samme vei drepte tre personer, ifølge forsvarskilder. I tillegg ble et mål knyttet til Abu Abdul Rahman al-Libi angrepet nær Qara i Syria.

approved.en: Iraqi authorities are disarming PKK-linked Yazidi militias, including YBŞ and YJŞ, and integrating them into the army and interior ministry while pledging to protect Yazidi rights and Mount Shengal. approved.en: Drone strikes in the disputed Abyei border region have killed dozens of civilians, with Sudanese forces blaming the RSF for the attacks. Communal clashes linked to cattle rustling in South Sudan have left at least ten people dead, and a violent incident at Akol Koor’s residence has led to a lawsuit before the judiciary. Two prisoners of war are scheduled to return home from Akobo, while the governor has urged General John Kenyi Latio to end fighting in Wonduruba. Riek Machar denied commanding the White Army in court and political parties and civil society signed a peace pledge ahead of the 2026 elections, according to reports.

Kommunale sammenstøt knyttet til kyrtyveri i Sør-Sudan har etterlatt minst ti personer drept, og en voldelig hendelse i Akol Koor sin bolig har ført til en rettssak i domstolene. To krigsfanger er planlagt å bli sendt hjem fra Akobo, mens guvernøren har oppfordret general John Kenyi Latio til å avslutte kampene i Wonduruba. Riek Machar benektet å ha ledet White Army i retten, og politiske partier og sivilsamfunnet signerte et fredsløfte før valget i 2026, ifølge rapporter.

approved.en: Fitgharan forces now hold the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another Bay town, extending combat in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and a senior al-Shabaab figure was killed by Somali intelligence. Heavy fighting erupted near Baidoa and in Burijeed as Laftagareen forces attacked army positions, prompting UN calls to halt the fighting amid famine, displacement and flood risks. Ethiopia has withdrawn more than 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict. 2,284 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Fitgharan-styrkene kontrollerer nå korridoren mellom Mogadishu og Baidoa, mens Laftagareen-styrkene har erobret Buurhakaba og en annen by i Bay, og utvider kampene i sørlige Somalia. Al-Shabaab detonerte en IED i Mandera, og seks sivile ble skadet, og en høytstående al-Shabaab-person ble drept av somalisk etterretning. Kraftige kamper brøt ut nær Baidoa og i Burijeed da Laftagareen-styrkene angrep hærens posisjoner, noe som førte til at FN oppfordret til å stoppe kampene midt i hungersnød, fordrivelse og flomrisiko. Etiopia har trukket tilbake mer enn 3 000 soldater og vil ikke gripe inn i konflikten i South West State. 2 284 dødsfall knyttet til kamp ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Gunmen attacked civilians in Plateau, killing a 60-year-old woman harvesting groundnuts and injuring two farmers, while Fulani attackers killed a farmer and wounded another. In Taraba, bandits killed dozens of villagers, with reports of 52 bodies buried and later 58 bodies recovered from a market attack. Bandits also struck near Sokoto University, prompting police confirmation of the assault. Northern senators have demanded the arrest and prosecution of the perpetrators of the Taraba attacks. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
